response.original_title: How to Add A Passenger to Your Royal Caribbean Cruises Reservation
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing reservation, call Royal Caribbean Cruises Customer Service at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be processed online. To add a passenger to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruises booking, you must call Royal Caribbean customer service directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) contact your original travel agent, as passenger additions cannot be processed online. Adding a guest depends on your stateroom's maximum capacity (such as sofa beds or Pullmans) and the ship's overall lifeboat and occupancy limits. If your current room is full, you may need to book an additional cabin. Dial +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or reach out to your travel advisor.
